Overthinking Music | Meditation Music with Surbahar | 1 Hour

Some days the noise inside your head is louder than anything outside. This is for those days.

One unbroken hour of Surbahar playing Raga Bhairavi, tuned to 432Hz healing frequency, with a subliminal Alpha wave layer to ease an overactive mind.

🎵 What you'll hear:
- surbahar
- 432Hz — classic healing frequency tuned to natural harmony
- A subliminal Alpha wave entrainment layer
- Seamless loops with smooth crossfades throughout

⏱ Chapters
0:00   Settling
7:00   Mind softening
30:00   Stillness peak
49:00   Coming back

🧠 How to use:
Find a quiet space. Let the music play in the background — don't force focus on it. Within 10–15 minutes, the mental chatter slows on its own.

⏱ Best for:
• Calming an overactive mind
• Anxiety relief
• Mental rest
• Pre-sleep wind-down
